count_scope: Live Entrez search result counts; not a frozen census, downloaded works, independent authors, suitable text count, or human-origin labels. Journal counts are subsets of total, not additive to it.

metadata_examples.access_notes: Search renderer exposed full Chinese article; direct article-page openings returned a browser-check page. The official OAI metadata endpoint returned publisher-deposited JATS front matter without authentication. No CAPTCHA solved or page restriction bypassed. Machine full-text retrieval is supported via documented APIs, not ordinary-page scraping.

metadata_examples.name_alternatives: Chinese and romanized names belong to the same contrib node, not independent authors
metadata_examples.access_notes: Official OAI front matter returned successfully. Specific machine-readable CC BY 3.0 and text-mining license references coexist with generic all-rights-reserved notice. Preserve both rather than dropping the specific open-license declaration.

access_contract.oa_web_service_status: retired 2026-08-25; do not use old oa.fcgi workflows
access_contract.oai_constraints: No concurrent requests; at most 3 requests per second; >100 requests outside weekday 05:00-21:00 US Eastern; Accept-Encoding gzip, deflate
access_contract.s3_access: Anonymous HTTPS or --no-sign-request, no AWS account or payment needed
access_contract.s3_terms: Read README before use: NLM acknowledgement, no implied endorsement/logo use, redistributed data must be current or conspicuously dated; article-level licenses still control

identity_contract.work_group: PMCID plus DOI/preprint/correction relationships where established
identity_contract.representation: publisher version vs author manuscript recorded separately
identity_contract.immutable_observation: PMCID + source version + exact object URL + retrieval timestamp + source MD5/ETag + locally computed SHA-256
identity_contract.warning: PMC version numbers reflect deposit processing, not every update or version preference. Content/metadata may change without version increment. Higher version is not automatically final/newest.

admission_cautions: Check article-level license URI, terms and third-party exceptions before body acquisition
Keep Chinese body, Chinese abstract and English translated abstract distinct; never count translations as independent works
Byline coauthors, corresponding authors, investigators, translators and editors are different roles; do not assign entire prose to first/corresponding author
Same romanized name is not verified same natural person; use ORCID/affiliation/explicit disambiguation where available
Medical case reports and identifiable patient narratives need privacy screening; prefer aggregate experimental/method/review strata initially
Journal, field, period, task, team and publication templates are confounded; a biomedical archive is not general Chinese academic prose
Split by work/version/translation family and near-duplicate cluster before evaluating author/team or topic transfer
No historical date, peer review or CC license proves unassisted human production
